reviews.review: Absolutely the best Warhammer 40,000 game out there. A must play not only for WH40K fans for but for anyone who wants to be a kick ass superhuman destroying absolutely everything. For the glory of the Emperor!

The game is good if you like Warhammer 40K lore and/or the Ultramarines.  But I cannot recommend it due to the fact the online multiplayer is broken beyond all recognition and the community is rather toxic. To start with: the multiplayer servers are terrible; constant host migration mid-game breaks up the flow of play - and that's assuming the servers let you in to a game in the first place! I've had multiple instances of the server finding potential games and refusing to connect to any of them.
As far as match play is concerned: It's impossible to get kills due to having no decent perks as I'm a low level. This means that whenever a new player is targeted by a higher level or vice versa the higher level will win nine times out of ten due to having a weapon perk that will increase weapon damage or improve accuracy or a defensive perk which will increase their shield strength making them nigh on impossible to kill. Additionally, the stunning feature for melee is incredibly selective and only works half the time.

Otherwise when attaining kills they are invariably credited to other players who were not near the kill in question. As an example In my most recent game I shot three unshielded enemies in the head with my boltgun; every single time the kill was credited to a higher-ranked ally who went on to complain about carrying his noob teammates in the after-game lobby.

Because of this it is impossible to unlock weapon perks such as kraken rounds for the boltgun as it is based on attaining a set number of kills.

Additionally, hacking is rife in the community. I've repeatedly been shot through walls and I've been killed by enemies who apparently had shield strength above 0% at my moment of death even though I could clearly see I was hitting their health bar when they killed me.

It's a shame this game is now out of development cycle as I have great memories playing it on console.

This game is visceral and extremely fun and satisfying to play, especially the equivalent of the sniper rifle, this is what I imagine a bolter actually sounding like. I highly recommend this game to anyone new to WarHammer 40k or anyone that is familiar to 40k but hasn't picked this up yet. You don't need to know every single piece of the lore of 40k to understand what's going on: Orks invade planet, Orks are bad, you kill Orks. The main gripe I have with this game, other than the late game enemies just being bolter sponges, not wishing to delve into spoiler territory but the ending is very sequal baity, and seeing that Relic have moved onto strictly RTS games, I doubt there will be a sequal. Fulfilling ending or not, I highly recommend this game for anyone who is looking for a good 3rd person shooter or looking to begin delving into the crevasse that is WarHammer 40k.

Singleplayer is enjoyable if you wanna de-stress by hacking, slashing and shooting Orks and Heretics by the hordes.

Multiplayer, I'm a bit "eeehhhh" on, since I can't reccommend going it alone nor can I reccommend against it, but I've found Multiplayer to be most fun when you have a group of friends to enjoy it with.

Storyline is good, but my only issue is where in the hell are the Skitarii of Graia?

You'd think that the defenders of the Forge World would be there in great number, especially considering Graia has a whole Legion of Skitarii tied to it.
